$comment: Falcon V2 parts, front to back. dims are inches used by tools/blender to build geometry; explode is metres in the Falcon's local frame (x right, y up, z forward toward the lens). confidence: measured = from a spec sheet or a teardown with part numbers; estimated = sized from the published envelope and photos; disputed = sources disagree.

parts.name: Front bezel and lens window
parts.function: Weather seal and optical window. The hood over the top keeps rain and low sun off the glass.

spec.Rating: Flex variant IP65; base Falcon rating unpublished

parts.name: Infrared illuminator board
parts.function: Six high-power emitters in a ring around the lens light the plate at night. Independent optical measurement puts them at 850 nm, pulsed at 10 Hz. An orange dome sensor next to the ring meters ambient light to decide when to fire.

spec.Wavelength: 850 nm (measured); teardown photos read as warm-white
spec.Pulse: 20 ms on / 80 ms off, up to ~40 strobes per capture

parts.name: M12 fixed-focus lens, ~16 mm
parts.function: A long, narrow lens. The field of view is about 15 ft wide at 65 ft, which is why one camera covers two lanes and nothing else.

parts.name: Mechanical IR-cut filter
parts.function: A solenoid swings an infrared-blocking filter out of the optical path at night so the sensor can see the illuminator, and back in by day so colours read true.

parts.name: Camera module
parts.function: About five megapixels, half-inch format, tuned for infrared. It takes six to twelve stills per passing vehicle; it does not record continuous video.

spec.Interface: Fine-pitch flex cable to the mainboard, CAM_3V3 rail
spec.Note: The IMX477 marking may not be a genuine Sony part; resolution does not match a real IMX477

parts.name: Passive infrared motion sensor
parts.function: The trigger. It fires on warm moving objects: cars, but also people, cyclists and animals. Everything downstream starts here.

spec.Position: Below the lens ring behind a small window

parts.name: Mainboard
parts.function: The carrier board: power stage, SIM socket, micro-USB debug port, and the headers everything else stacks onto. Silkscreened Flock Safety Inc. 2022.

spec.Rails: 3.3 V, 1.8 V, 1.2 V; 12 V to the LED board
spec.Debug: Micro-USB, test points; shipped as a debug build with an unlocked bootloader

parts.name: System on module
parts.function: A phone-class Qualcomm APQ8053 (Snapdragon 624/625 family) running Android 8.1. This is the edge computer: plate recognition and the Vehicle Fingerprint attributes are computed here before anything is transmitted.

spec.Models: YOLO and OpenCV pipelines on device

parts.name: Storage
parts.function: 32 GB of flash for the operating system and the short-lived image queue. Flock says images are removed from the device once the cloud acknowledges the upload; the Flex sheet describes about two weeks of local buffer.

spec.Buffer: ~2 weeks offline (Flex sheet); standard Falcon unspecified

parts.name: LTE modem
parts.vendor: Sierra Wireless; older units NimbeLink Skywire NL-SW-LTE-S7648
parts.function: The only way data leaves the pole. Crops and metadata go out over a carrier SIM Flock pays for; there is no Ethernet. Because Flock uses pre-certified modules, the Falcon itself has no FCC filing and no public internal photos.

spec.Bearer: LTE; carrier depends on area (Verizon Business and AT&T SIMs documented)
spec.Category: Cat-1 vs Cat-4 reported for the same FCC ID; unresolved
spec.Placement: Daughter module stacked above the SOM

parts.name: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth module
parts.function: Off in normal operation. During install or a fault the camera raises a Wi-Fi access point named flock-XXXXXX so a technician can aim it from a phone; the external battery box reports its health over Bluetooth.

parts.name: GPS patch antenna
parts.function: Stamps every photo with a location. A 17 mm active patch, sky-facing, on a U.FL pigtail.

spec.Receiver: Discrete or in the modem; not confirmed

parts.name: Rear shell, connector and label
parts.function: The back half of the enclosure carries the weatherproof DC input from the solar and battery leads, the antenna stubs, and the QR label that encodes the part number, IMEI, MAC, SIM and Flock serial number.

spec.Label: QR: pn, imei, mac, sim, fsn

parts.name: Band clamps and mounting boss
parts.function: Two adjustable stainless bands wrap the pole. Flock's own pole is 2.875 in outside diameter, the same as the camera's width.

spec.Height: 8 to 12 ft on existing poles; ~10 ft on the 12 ft Flock pole
